title: Eventual Fourier weight gain
statement: For all sufficiently large integers $q$, the level-one Fourier weight of the small-set indicator is at least $\frac{1}{36}\Delta_q^2\log(1/\Delta_q)$, where $\Delta_q$ is twice its uniform mass.
